label: ElevenLabs
agentGuide: Base path /v1. Account and credits: GET /v1/user (subscription.character_count, character_limit). Voices: GET /v1/voices (voices[].voice_id, name, labels). Speak: POST /v1/text-to-speech/<voice_id> {"text": "...", "model_id": "eleven_multilingual_v2"} — the answer is MP3 bytes: always use save_as (name.mp3). Add ?output_format=mp3_44100_128. Sound effects: POST /v1/sound-generation {"text": "rain on a window"} (mp3, save_as). History: GET /v1/history; an item's audio: GET /v1/history/<id>/audio (save_as). Models: GET /v1/models. Every character spoken is billed. The key is set by Allkin.
